text: Hoogh!

text: It's good to hear that. I knew that the outside world couldn't be as bad as everyone says. I mean, our ancestors lived outside, right? But that paranoid Overseer won't let us leave.

text: Actually, it's pretty bad out there.

text: You're right; the outside world isn't all that bad.

text: The Overseer is simply trying to protect us. The outside world is dangerous to the unprepared.

text: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. I hope that you're able to find the chip soon.

text: Shouldn't be a problem.

text: With all of the hazards I've been running in to, it may take some time.

text: Hmm. I suppose it was too much to hope that the outside world had taught you to communicate. Oh well.

Hmm. I suppose it was too much to hope that the outside
 world had taught you to communicate. Oh well.

text: And I suppose he chose you to go outside because he knew that you were under his thumb! He really just doesn't want to give up his control over us.
source_text:
And I suppose he chose you to go outside because he knew that
 you were under his thumb! He really just doesn't want to give
 up his control over us.

text: I resent that remark!
source_text: I resent that remark!

text: Actually, I think he believes that there's no reason to risk survival outside while it's still safe in here.
source_text:
Actually, I think he believes that there's no reason to risk
 survival outside while it's still safe in here.

text: Hmm. From what I've read, the outside isn't really all that dangerous. But I suppose that you would know better than I, wouldn't you?
source_text:
Hmm. From what I've read, the outside isn't really all that
 dangerous. But I suppose that you would know better than I,
 wouldn't you?

text: I knew that the outside couldn't be too bad. That's why I've been trying to convince some people to come outside with me. I think that we have a better chance of survival out there.
source_text:
I knew that the outside couldn't be too bad. That's why I've been
 trying to convince some people to come outside with me. I think

text: What are you smoking!?
source_text: What are you smoking!?

text: That's probably a good idea.
source_text: That's probably a good idea.

text: I suppose. I always figured that he just had some sort of power trip. But I guess that he wouldn't be the Overseer if he wasn't really concerned about our welfare, would he? I guess we should just wait and see if you can find the chip.
source_text:
I suppose. I always figured that he just had some sort of power
 trip. But I guess that he wouldn't be the Overseer if he wasn't

 just wait and see if you can find the chip.

text: Don't worry, I'll take care of it.
source_text: Don't worry, I'll take care of it.

text: Oh, come on! Wake up! If he thinks the outside is so dangerous, then how come he sent you out there? The man just has a control complex. You're a stupid tool and you don't even know it!
source_text:
Oh, come on! Wake up! If he thinks the outside is so dangerous,
 then how come he sent you out there? The man just has a control
 complex. You're a stupid tool and you don't even know it!

text: Honestly, if he thought that the outside was that dangerous, he'd have sent a whole team with weapons and equipment, not just you. But you're his pawn, since he doesn't want anyone to realize what they're missing.
source_text:
Honestly, if he thought that the outside was that dangerous,
 he'd have sent a whole team with weapons and equipment, not
 just you. But you're his pawn, since he doesn't want anyone
 to realize what they're missing.

text: Oh, get real! Do you really think that we can live in this Vault generation after generation? Maybe you can find a new chip, but what happens when the next thing breaks down? And the next?
source_text:
Oh, get real! Do you really think that we can live in this Vault
 generation after generation? Maybe you can find a new chip,
 but what happens when the next thing breaks down? And the next?

text: Huh. I guess you're right.
source_text: Huh. I guess you're right.

text: Maybe we can't stay here forever. But rushing out into the world without preparation and without the consent of the group isn't the answer.
source_text:
Maybe we can't stay here forever. But rushing out into the world
 without preparation and without the consent of the group isn't
 the answer.

text: A lot of us think so. That's why we're planning to take some supplies and head out in a few days. Say, do you have any advice for us?
source_text:
A lot of us think so. That's why we're planning to take some
 supplies and head out in a few days. Say, do you have any
 advice for us?

text: Sorry, I haven't really found much out there.
source_text: Sorry, I haven't really found much out there.

text: You could head to this little village called Shady Sands, a few days east. They might help.
source_text:
You could head to this little village called Shady Sands,
 a few days east. They might help.

text: Okay. Well, thanks.
source_text: Okay. Well, thanks.

text: Oh, just go away! We don't need the help of one of the Overseer's pawns!
source_text:
Oh, just go away! We don't need the help of one of the
 Overseer's pawns!

text: Welcome to our meeting! As you have been picked by the Overseer to go outside, perhaps you can give us some advice before our move to the outdoors as well.
source_text:
Welcome to our meeting! As you have been picked by the Overseer
 to go outside, perhaps you can give us some advice before our
 move to the outdoors as well.

text: Don't drink glowing water.
source_text: Don't drink glowing water.

text: Yeah . . . don't go.
source_text: Yeah . . . don't go.

text: I think that your plans to leave are ill-advised.
source_text: I think that your plans to leave are ill-advised.

text: Hoooot!
source_text: Hoooot!

text: Thank you so much. I can see you're going to be a big help. Why don't you just leave?

Thank you so much. I can see you're going to be a big help. Why don't
 you just leave?

text: Sorry, I'm here to hear all of this.
source_text: Sorry, I'm here to hear all of this.

text: Fine then.
source_text: Fine then.

text: Really? Considering our position, our lack of water, and the original purpose of this Vault, why do you think that we should stay?
source_text:
Really? Considering our position, our lack of water, and the
 original purpose of this Vault, why do you think that we should stay?

text: It's just a bad idea, is all.
source_text: It's just a bad idea, is all.

text: The outside world is too dangerous to the unprepared. It's best to have time to make proper preparations before going. The Overseer is trying to give the Vault that needed time.
source_text:
The outside world is too dangerous to the unprepared. It's best
 to have time to make proper preparations before going. The

text: Well, considering that you have some experience with the outside, perhaps you have some valuable points to make.

Well, considering that you have some experience with the
 outside, perhaps you have some valuable points to make.

text: The outside is too dangerous and hostile. You wouldn't last long.
source_text: The outside is too dangerous and hostile. You wouldn't last long.

text: I just need a little more time to find the water chip.
source_text: I just need a little more time to find the water chip.

text: If you can't give us good reasons why we shouldn't leave, then we're not going to wait here and die of water poisoning. Please don't get in our way.
source_text:
If you can't give us good reasons why we shouldn't leave, then

text: Sorry, folks, I can't let you do this.

text: Very well. It's your choice.

text: It's only a matter of time before we run out of water here. But the Vault was never meant to keep people inside forever! We have the people and the supplies to move outside now. We have a better chance.

text: Hmm. Perhaps you're right. There are probably other survivors out there, and they could be hostile, too. I guess we will need to wait for everyone else to be ready.
